messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 QBR: Headcount Triage & Req Prioritization

Team —

As we lock slides for the Q3 QBR next week, we need a rapid triage of outstanding headcount requests and any proposed backfills. Finance flagged our provisional HC ceiling for Q3 last Friday; we will not get an increased budget unless we reprioritize some requests now.

I attached the raw Q3 HC requests export (q3-hc-requests.xlsx). Action items: please review the spreadsheet and reply with a one-line disposition for each req you own (Approve / Defer / Freeze) and a short rationale. Key constraints:

- Hiring budget ceiling: we should target <= 18 net new FTEs for Q3 to stay within the provisional plan.
- Backfills for customer-facing ops should be prioritized if they impact revenue retention.
- Engineering infra and production reliability roles have a paired capital ask; we can consider shifting budget from other buckets if leadership agrees.

I propose we treat this as an ACUTE triage (not a full HC planning cycle): 48-hour turn. I'll compile and bring a recommendation to the QBR. If you need to loop in Recruiters or an external partner, cc Parker & Co (matt@parkerco.com).

Regards,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product & Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: q3-hc-requests.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 08:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 QBR: Headcount Triage & Req Prioritization

+1 on the 48-hour window. I ran a quick pass and attached a one-page prioritization matrix (hc-priorities-v1.xlsx) with my suggested buckets and rationale. High-level thoughts:

- Revenue retention / CS backfills (3 reqs) -> APPROVE. We risk churn if not staffed.
- Critical infra (Prod Infra Eng x2) -> APPROVE but recommend partial funding shift from internal tooling.
- New R&D bets (2 ML research hires) -> DEFER unless we find external grant/partner funding.
- Sales quota-bearing hires (AE ramp) -> CONDITIONAL APPROVE tied to Q2 ARR triggers.

I added notes on impact and estimated time-to-ramp for each role. Two asks:
1) Can Recruiting commit an expedited timeline for CS backfills (30 days)? CCing Jonas to confirm.
2) If we approve infra, we should pair with a canary budget commit for the dedicated cluster pilots — otherwise we have performance risk.

Quick note from CS perspective —

We have two critical backfills in North America (CSM Sr. x1, Onboarding Manager x1) where timelines directly map to three renewals in August. If those renewals are staffed, we expect to avoid $420k of churn risk. Per my read: APPROVE both backfills now; we can deprioritize one exploratory research hire to offset budget.

Recruiting: Matt — can you confirm earliest start dates if we push these to high priority? I prefer not to use external contractors for customer-facing roles unless absolutely necessary.

Thank you all — consolidated decision below (this will be the recommendation I present in the QBR):

- Approve now (move to active reqs): CS Backfills (CSM Sr., Onboarding Manager) — 2 FTEs. Recruiters: expedite; target 30-day pipeline; use internal bench before contractors.
- Approve contingent (finance offset required): Production Infra Eng x2 — 2 FTEs. Rishi to confirm offset (R&D discretionary -> defer 1 exploratory ML role).
- Defer: ML research hires x2 -> move to Q4 if no external funding.
- Conditional AE hires: 3 quota-bearing AEs -> move to conditional approval tied to ARR check at end of month.

Jonas: please coordinate with Recruiting and confirm earliest start windows. Laura: please update the HC tracker and push the new statuses to the shared sheet. I updated the priorities sheet here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcDEFq3HcPriorities (look for the QBR tab).

I'll include this slide in the QBR pack; let me know if you want a short talking point for the Operations section.

Vivek
